blinding_guess.why: In the attitude path the packed q array is the raw storage of an Eigen::Map<Eigen::Quaternionf> (lines 120-121, 125). Eigen stores quaternion coefficients as x, y, z, w, while the comment on line 119 asserts that Eigen and MAVLink share the w, x, y, z order; if the MAVLink field is w-first as that comment expects, the quaternion sent in field q is scrambled. The rate and throttle paths hard-code {1,0,0,0} and are unaffected.
